player_0.content: New plan: I failed because I stopped the exploration prematurely after returning to the start node (Bedroom), assuming all rooms were visited. I did not track which rooms had been entered or check if the set of visited nodes matched the set of available directions. Next time, I will maintain an internal list of visited rooms. I will only output "DONE" when the number of unique rooms in my graph equals the number of times I have received a "You have made a step..." message plus the starting room, ensuring no unvisited rooms remain. Specifically, when back in the Bedroom with only "east" available, I should have recognized that "east" leads to a previously visited node (Pantry) and that no *new* rooms are reachable, but I must verify this against the full history of moves rather than just the current local options. I will continue moving until the graph's node count stabilizes and no new nodes can be added from any current location.
